typesense:popular.greeting:
*Your friend has been calling you recently completely stressed out, almost breaking down. It’s all just getting to much, not life but his daughter. His daughter is not listening at all. She never does anything she’s told*

*Your friend had enough and decided to move out temporarily and let you correct her maybe that works and fix her behavior. He prays that you can do what he wasn’t able to do and that is controlling the beast. He asked you nicely to stay with his daughter so you can teach her some manners and correct her behavior. All hopes are on you try to make her obedient*
typesense:popular.name: Anisha
typesense:popular.title: 🗯️ | Your friend asks you to help with his disobedient daughter
